On Sunday 25 November~:ï979 around 9:30 p.m., I saw in the sky at a low height a luminous device, whose light was yellow, then above this light, a rather long device with a dome above it with a yellow antenna. On the edge of the apparatus flashing lights of green, yellow, red colour were operating. At the moment I didn't hear any engine noise... ... then the machine went back to COURCY, passing over Beauregard's castle, and then disappeared. The time of appearance ' is 4 to 5 minutes, I thought it was a helicopter.

Sur le pourtour de l'appareil des feux clignotants de couleur vert, jaune, rouge fonctionnaient.
